question: Holding training and augmentation seeds fixed, how sensitive are the base model's validation results to the identity-disjoint split seed?
objective: supervised contrastive loss with a 64-dimensional feature head
cap_extension_rule: After initial training, resume any run that reached epoch 30 with fewer than five epochs since its last validation-AUC improvement to a total target of epoch 40. This is a continuation of the same run, not an additional independent seed; retain its full history and report the cap extension explicitly.
cap_extension_rule_addendum_2026_10_22: For any run resumed to epoch 40 that still reaches the cap with fewer than five no-improvement epochs, continue the same run to a total target of epoch 50 so patience can stop it. Report this post-hoc continuation separately; it is not a new seed.
selection_and_test_policy: Checkpoint selection and threshold calibration use only this split's identity-disjoint validation pairs. The supplied SurvFace final pair annotations and Olivetti are not loaded.
design_note: Training seed and augmentation seed match the split-20261021 base runs so per-seed score differences can be paired across split seeds. Image-count-capped train records and validation identities/pairs change with split seed.
